scene: Dream-siren exposed, angel removes sloth's fourth P, avaricious souls lie face-down and Adrian V speaks
story: Near dawn Dante dreams of a woman who at first appears stammering, distorted and pale. As he looks, she grows beautiful and sings as a seductive siren, claiming the power to hold travelers from their path.
A holy woman calls to Virgil to expose the deception. Virgil tears open the siren's garments, revealing her foul belly and breaking the charm. Dante awakens as the dream vanishes.

Virgil urges Dante to keep his gaze directed toward the higher path. At the departure from the terrace of sloth, a radiant angel directs the ascent and removes another P from Dante's forehead; the count falls from four to three.

The travelers enter the fifth terrace, where souls lie face-down against the earth, weeping and reciting that their souls cleave to the dust. Their former attachment to earthly wealth is corrected through contact with the ground.

Dante addresses a penitent who identifies himself as Adrian V. Adrian says that becoming pope showed him the vanity of worldly station and that his earthly tenure was brief. He asks Dante to request prayers from his niece Alagia.
When Dante kneels in deference to the pope, Adrian discourages it, saying they are fellow servants before God. Dante and Virgil continue; the fifth terrace has begun but its mark remains.

semanticSomatic.semantic: A seductive appearance can mislead; waking and redirected attention restore the path

semanticSomatic.actor: Holy woman and Virgil in dream
semanticSomatic.semantic: The revealed underside contradicts the siren's persuasive surface
The completed correction of sloth requires a witnessed erasure, not the dream alone
Rank does not justify worship; brief power and wealth cannot confer lasting worth

witnesses.action: DREAM the siren's apparent beauty and WATCH Virgil EXPOSE the deception
witnesses.observable: vision is a dream, not a present encounter with a real siren

witnesses.action: AWAKEN, FOLLOW Virgil, and RECEIVE the angel's cleansing
witnesses.observable: forehead P count changes from four to three

witnesses.action: SEE the face-down penitents and HEAR Adrian V's confession and request for Alagia's prayers
witnesses.observable: penance visible; Adrian's previous life is his testimony; three marks remain

alchemicalReading: Desire's alluring image is tested against its concealed nature. A witnessed transition releases sloth's mark; the next terrace turns attachment to earthly goods face-down.
invariant: Dream images do not establish events outside the dream. Only the angel's observed cleansing changes 4 P to 3 P; the terrace of avarice is not yet cleansed.
